data.title: 贝塔 · 黄昏课桌间的藏匿手札
data.description: 空无一人的学院教室后排窗边，橙红夕照拉长课桌阴影。学妹装扮的贝塔将写满暗影大人的秘密日记慌乱藏入书包，脸颊绯红。
data.location: empty sunlit classroom by tall wooden framed window overlooking courtyard
data.action: standing hurriedly by classroom desk, tucking an embossed leather diary into satchel with flushed cheeks and wide flustered eyes
data.lighting: 窗棂透入的浓郁黄昏暖金光
data.promptProse: In a golden sunset classroom, Beta disguised as an academy student hurriedly conceals her secret diary in her bag, blushing heavily with startled eyes.
data.animaCaption: Warm sunset through the window catches her flushed cheeks as she hides her journal.
